Annotation layer of dynamic spectrograms

Source: R/dynaspec.R
ds_annotations.Rd

ds_annotations() highlights parts of the sound in a dynaspec() object with translucent boxes (e.g. calls, songs or the parts of a duet), optionally with borders and labels, or with horizontal lines above the sounds (e.g. to show which individual sings each part of a duet).

Usage

ds_annotations(
  X,
  col = NULL,
  alpha = 0.3,
  type = "box",
  border = NULL,
  lwd = 1,
  lty = 1,
  labels = NULL,
  cex = 1,
  freq = TRUE,
  sound.file = NULL,
  line.freq = NULL
)

Arguments

X

Data frame with the selections: columns 'start' and 'end' (in s) and, optionally, 'bottom.freq' and 'top.freq' (in kHz) to restrict boxes to a frequency range. Selection tables from 'warbleR' (or tables from 'ohun' or 'Rraven') can be used directly (see details). Extended selection tables are not supported.

col

Color of the boxes, or the name of a column of 'X' with the color of each box. Default is NULL: 'col.annotation' of ds_theme(), or "#E69F00".

alpha

Opacity of the boxes or lines (0-1). Default is 0.3 (1 for lines).

type

Character string: "box" (translucent boxes), "spectrogram" (the spectrogram is colored within each selection, with a gradient from the spectrogram background to the color of the selection, as warbleR::color_spectro(); only borders and labels are drawn on top) or "line" (a horizontal line from the start to the end of each selection at the frequency set by 'line.freq', drawn on spectrograms only; labels are shown above the lines). Default is "box".

border

Color of the box borders, or the name of a column of 'X' with the border color of each box. Default is NULL (no borders).

lwd

Width of the box borders, or of the lines when type = "line". Default is 1 (8 for lines).

lty

Line type of the box borders (or of the lines), as in graphics::par(): an integer (0-6) or a name ("solid", "dashed", "dotted", "dotdash", "longdash" or "twodash"). Default is 1 (solid).

labels

Name of a column of 'X' with labels to show at the top of each box (or above each line). Default is NULL (no labels).

cex

Size of the labels. Default is 1.

freq

Logical to control if the frequency range of selections is used (when 'X' has 'bottom.freq' and 'top.freq' columns). If FALSE boxes span the whole frequency range. Default is TRUE.

sound.file

Name of the sound file whose selections are shown, when 'X' has a 'sound.files' column with several sound files. Default is NULL: when the sound of dynaspec() is a file, the selections of that file are shown (matching the file name); otherwise 'X' must contain a single sound file.

line.freq

Frequency (in kHz) at which lines are drawn when type = "line", or the name of a column of 'X' with the frequency of each line (e.g. a different height for each individual of a duet). Default is NULL: near the top of the spectrogram (90% of the frequency range shown).

Value

A layer to be added to a dynaspec() object with +. Several annotation layers can be added.

Details

Tables with a 'sound.files' column (e.g. 'warbleR' selection tables) can contain selections of several sound files; only those of the sound shown are used (see 'sound.file').

See also

dynaspec(), ds_captions()

Examples

data(scythebill)

# note types
st <- data.frame(start = c(0.34, 1.13, 1.44, 1.75), end = c(1.03, 1.36, 1.68, 2.28),
                 labels = c("A", "B", "B", "C"),
                 colors = c("#E69F00", "#56B4E9", "#56B4E9", "#009E73"))

x <- dynaspec(scythebill, flim = c(1.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 200, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) +
  ds_annotations(st, col = "colors", labels = "labels")

# dashed borders of the same color as the boxes
x <- x + ds_annotations(st, col = "colors", alpha = 0.1, border = "colors", lwd = 2, lty = "dashed")

# spectrogram colored within the selections
x <- dynaspec(scythebill, flim = c(1.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 200, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) +
  ds_annotations(st, col = "colors", type = "spectrogram")

# lines above the notes (one height per note type)
st$line.freq <- c(4.6, 4.9, 4.9, 5.2)
x <- dynaspec(scythebill, flim = c(1.5, 5.5)) +
  ds_spectrogram(wl = 200, collevels = seq(-50, 0, 1)) +
  ds_annotations(st, col = "colors", type = "line", line.freq = "line.freq", labels = "labels")
